countQualifications: Model-audit records include excluded/not-current entries, future-delivery orders, chassis families and specialist import offers. They are not a count of presently purchasable complete vehicles.
Named entries include wheelbase/battery/body/package choices and partial matrices, not universally independent marketing trims.
Bus chassis, supplier bodies and completed buses are not additive vehicle counts. Body platforms and terminal equipment stay outside records.
Only six duplicate family observations were merged; distinct supplier/chassis relationships remain documented rather than guessed.
All numerical specification rankings remain disabled for audit records; detailed BYD facts live in their separate evidence artifact.
comparisonRules: Use vehicleClass plus compatible configuration/test basis for rankings.
Distinguish passenger seats from bus total standing+seated capacity.
Compare chassis-only and completed-body payload/cargo only with matching body/GVM conditions.
Do not compare commercial duty-cycle maxima with WLTP passenger range.
Quote-only/fleet-contract price is null, never zero.

proposedECrewRecord.evidenceNote: EV Automotive retains a dedicated Australian EC11 E-Crew passenger-minibus listing with locally completed built-to-order interiors and capacity up to 12 including the driver. Current exact-build availability is unconfirmed; its order selector still names EOFY-2024 runout.
limitations: E-Crew and E-Cargo are separately marketed passenger and goods bodies within the common Skywell EC11 model/platform. This row is an additional body-offering audit record only, not a new canonical vehicle family, verified configuration or purchasable complete vehicle.

The importer currently publishes a built-to-order passenger-minibus offering, but the order selector explicitly retains EOFY-2024 stock-runout wording. Current order acceptance, allocation, delivery timing and physical unused stock are not established.

Up to 12 occupants including the driver is a product-family capacity, not the seating of an identified delivered build. Seat styles, upholstery, minor layouts and wheelchair-access options are not independent verified trims.

The shared EC11 brochure describes local interior completion. The exact donor, build date, formal model year, prior registration, conversion/completion approval and completed-vehicle road-registration basis remain unverified; do not label a particular unit factory new or a used retrofit.
Bus/minibus is the census body class based on the passenger product description, not a verified ADR category. Wheelchair seating layouts must retain their own occupant and selected-build basis.

The separately linked skywell-ecargo-brochure.pdf describes indicative cargo floor/wall anchor locations. It is not evidence of E-Crew child-restraint, passenger-seat or wheelchair-restraint approval.
Importer sources conflict on AC duration, dimensions/overhangs, range basis and transmission labels. Preserve source-specific values without normalized technical ranking or E-Cargo payload transfer.
No exact trim, formal model year, contemporaneous price, contract warranty, accepted order, VIN, stock allocation or current completed build is established by this audit.
